messages:
matt: FYI support flagged another billing noise incident. Projectless keys briefly upgraded into project rateband and triggered quota alerts. Thinking we need a routing policy that favors billing stability over short-latency wins.

anya: can we separate routing from billing? route to project for perf but bill org unless sustained for some window.

kevin: that's similar to soft-band ideas. Implementation constraints: quota ledger expects immediate debit. We'd need shadow counters and a commit step.

matt: shadow counters ok, but require console visibility and searchable events. Support needs to query when a key was in shadow state.

sam: telemetry plan: add trace fields routing.target_band, billing.state (shadow|committed), billing.shadow_bytes. Index a tiny sample into logs.

kevin: rollout: gate behind feature flag, 2% keys -> 10% -> 100%. metrics: shadow_commits, shadow_aborts, project_quota_delta.

anya: add API to pin billing behavior per-key (pin_to_org, pin_to_project) with TTL options. audit log mandatory.

matt: also add decay for shadow counters (leaky bucket) to avoid accumulation from repeated short bursts.

ops-bot: feature flag soft_billing enabled on staging at 1718843240.

kevin: staging synthetic ran. found off-by-one in commit timer, patching now.

sam: will draft RFC and include billing export changes so downstream billing can reconcile shadow events.

matt: thanks. if RFC ready today I can triage PLAT ticket.

ops-bot: Created PLAT-7933: "Soft billing routing + shadow ledger RFC" assigned to kevin (https://tracker/redwood/PLAT-7933)
